title: Form 25 manufacturing licence — retention fee (every 5 years)
what: Licence stays valid only if the retention fee is paid before each 5-year anniversary of issue.
penalty: Late fee 2% of licence fee per month up to 6 months; unpaid after that = licence deemed cancelled.

title: Product permission before making any new product/strength
what: Each new product, strength or pack must be endorsed on the licence before manufacture (new drugs/FDCs need prior CDSCO approval first). Test batches need no separate Form 29 for Form 25 holders (r.89).
penalty: Manufacture without permission = offence under s.18 D&C Act; batch seizure.

title: Report change in competent/technical person within 1 month
what: Any change of approved technical staff (manufacturing/testing) or competent person (wholesale) must be reported to the licensing authority within one month.
penalty: Licence suspension/cancellation for breach of licence conditions.

title: Revised Schedule M (GMP) — annual self-assessment
what: Revised Schedule M binds every drug unit since 1 Jan 2026 (no further extension). Do a documented gap assessment each year and close gaps before state inspections.
penalty: Risk-based inspections; licence suspension for non-compliance.

title: Pharmacovigilance system — quarterly review
what: Keep a working PV system (PV officer, SOP, ADR log, reporting to CDSCO/PvPI). CDSCO circular of 3 Jun 2026 asks for immediate compliance.
law: Schedule M para 6.11; NDCT Rules 2019; CDSCO circular 03-06-2026
evidence: Quarterly PV review minutes + ADR log

title: PSUR for new drugs (6-monthly for 2 years, then yearly)
what: Only if Velite holds a new-drug marketing approval. Count from actual market launch date (CDSCO advisory Apr 2026).

title: Schedule H2 QR code — vaccines, anticancer, NDPS products
what: From 1 Jul 2027 every pack of these categories must carry the QR/bar code (primary, or secondary if no space). Check product list; prepare artwork + printing.

title: Schedule H2 QR code — all antimicrobials (antibiotics etc.)
what: From 1 Jul 2028 every antimicrobial formulation pack must carry the QR code.

title: Change control — regulatory impact check (post-approval changes)
what: Before changing process, excipient, pack, shelf life, specs or site: classify the change. Draft rules (Mar 2026) propose prior approval for major/moderate changes and an annual report in Q1 for minor ones — follow final notification.
evidence: Change control form with regulatory assessment

title: Label & artwork compliance check for each new/changed artwork
what: Rule 96 particulars, Schedule H/H1 warning box, Sch H2 code where applicable, MRP & price-list rules, licence no., batch, dates.

title: Check CDSCO monthly NSQ/spurious alert list
what: CDSCO publishes NSQ/spurious drug alerts monthly. Check if any Velite batch (or a batch you trade) is listed; start recall per SOP if so.

title: WHO-GMP certificate renewal (export)
what: WHO-GMP is typically valid 3 years; apply early — inspection needed.
penalty: Exports stop without a valid certificate.

title: COPP (per product) renewal
what: Certificate of Pharmaceutical Product per product/country; tied to WHO-GMP validity.

title: Export NOC for unapproved/banned drugs (per order)
what: Exporting a drug not approved/banned in India needs a CDSCO export NOC with the importer's purchase order.
law: Drugs Rules; CDSCO export NOC procedure

title: Form 20B/21B wholesale licence — retention fee (every 5 years)
what: Sale licences are perpetual if the retention fee (₹1,500 per form) is paid before each 5-year anniversary.
penalty: Late fee 2%/month up to 6 months, then deemed cancelled.

title: Wholesale records & storage check (monthly)
what: Purchase/sale records with batch & expiry, Schedule H1 register, sale only to licensed buyers, cold-chain/temperature log, competent person present.
law: Drugs Rules r.65 (conditions of sale licence)

title: COS-8 manufacturing licence — retention fee (every 5 years)
what: COS-8 is perpetual if the retention fee (₹10,000; ten items per category free) is paid before each 5-year anniversary.
penalty: Late fee 2%/month within 180 days; unpaid = deemed cancelled.

title: Add new product/category to COS-8 before manufacture
what: Beyond 10 items per category, ₹500 per extra item; new category ₹10,000. New cosmetic (new ingredient) needs COS-3 permission.

title: Cosmetic GMP (Seventh Schedule) — annual self-inspection
what: Premises, plant, records (Eighth Schedule) per Seventh Schedule; COS-7 self-certificate stays true.
authority: FDA Punjab (inspection at least once in 3 years)

title: Cosmetic label check for each new/changed artwork
what: Cosmetics Rules labelling + BIS standard of the category + Legal Metrology declarations (MRP, net qty, consumer care, date).
law: Cosmetics Rules 2020 r.34–36; LM (PC) Rules 2011 r.6

title: IPDMS 2.0 registration & product master up to date
what: All DPCO forms are filed on IPDMS 2.0 — keep company and product list current.

title: Form III — quarterly production/sales return (scheduled formulations)
what: Within 15 days of quarter end; NPPA OM of 23 Jun 2026 demands timely filing and backlog clearance.
penalty: Action under DPCO / Essential Commodities Act.

title: Annual WPI price revision — Form II within 15 days (scheduled)
what: Ceiling prices change every 1 April by WPI. Revise MRPs; file Form II within 15 days and issue Form V price list.

title: Form V price list on every new price/notification
what: Issue price list in Form V via IPDMS with copies to State Drugs Controller and dealers, within 15 days of revision.

title: Non-scheduled drugs — 10% annual MRP increase cap check
what: MRP of non-scheduled formulations may not rise more than 10% in 12 months.

title: New drug launch — Form I/IA within 1 month
what: Launching a 'new drug' under DPCO needs retail price fixation (Form I) or intimation (Form IA) within one month of launch (2026 amendment).

title: Form IV — 6 months' notice before discontinuing a scheduled product
what: Give at least six months' prior notice to NPPA before stopping production/import of a scheduled formulation.

title: Product Quality Review (PQR) for every product
what: Annual review of batches, deviations, OOS, changes, complaints, stability for each product.

title: Self-inspection / internal GMP audit
what: Planned internal audit of all departments; CAPA tracked to closure.

title: Instrument & equipment calibration due list
what: Check the calibration schedule; nothing used past its due date.

title: Purified water system — trend review
what: Chemical & micro results trended; sanitisation done as per SOP.

title: Stability programme — pull points
what: Ongoing stability: samples pulled & tested on time.

title: Vendor qualification & re-evaluation
what: Approved vendor list reviewed; audits of critical suppliers.

title: Annual training plan completed
what: GMP, hygiene, SOP and safety training with records.

title: Mock recall
what: Test the recall SOP with a mock recall of a distributed batch.

title: Validation & requalification (HVAC, equipment, cleaning)
what: Periodic requalification as per validation master plan.

title: Quality management review (deviations, CAPA, complaints)
what: Quarterly review of deviations, OOS, complaints, returns, CAPA effectiveness.

title: Staff medical examination
what: Annual medical check of production/packing staff (Schedule M health of personnel; OSH Code annual health check).

title: Pest control service record
what: Contracted pest control done and recorded.

title: Factory licence renewal
what: Licence up to 5 years (to 31 Dec of last year). Renew online in Form 2B; a factory is now 20+ workers with power (OSH Code).
law: Punjab Factory Rules 1952 r.10/10-A; OSH Code 2020

title: Factory half-yearly return (Jan–Jun)
what: Half-yearly return by 15 July.

title: Factory annual return
what: Annual return for the previous calendar year (filed online). Punjab OSH rules are still draft — format may change.

title: Fire safety certificate renewal
what: Validity by risk: 5 yrs low, 3 yrs medium, 1 yr high hazard. Apply one month before expiry.
law: Punjab Fire & Emergency Service Act 2024; Validity Rules 2025

title: Fire extinguishers refilled / fire system serviced
what: Annual refill/hydro-test and AMC of fire systems; mock drill.

title: Boiler certificate renewal
what: Certificate valid up to 12 months (24 for some unfired); inspection before renewal.
law: Boilers Act 2025 (in force 1 May 2025); Indian Boiler Regulations 2026
penalty: Using uncertified boiler: up to ₹1 lakh + ₹1,000/day.

title: Electrical installation inspection (CEIG / self-certification)
what: Periodic inspection of HT installations / DG sets.

title: Weighing scales & measures — verification/stamping
what: Every scale used for trade/packing must be verified and stamped (usually annual).
law: Legal Metrology Act 2009; Punjab LM (Enforcement) Rules

title: PESO licence (solvents/gas storage)
what: Storage above exempt limits needs PESO licence; renew before expiry.

title: Excise permit for rectified spirit / ethanol
what: Possession/transport of rectified spirit needs Punjab Excise permits/pass; keep spirit register.
law: Punjab Excise Act 1914; Liquor Permit & Pass Rules 1932

title: NDPS / controlled substance licences & returns
what: Manufacturing with narcotic/psychotropic or controlled precursors needs licences and periodic returns/registers.

title: Accident / dangerous occurrence report
what: Report serious accidents immediately to the Inspector (within hours) and record in the accident register.

title: Groundwater permission & monthly extraction charges
what: Industrial borewells need PWRDA permission, a meter and monthly charges; renew permission before expiry.

title: Insurance renewals (fire/stock, product liability, EC)
what: Keep fire & stock, product liability and employee compensation (non-ESI staff) policies alive.
law: Business protection; EC under SS Code for non-ESI staff

title: PPCB Consent to Operate (Air & Water) renewal
what: CTO usually 5 years. Expiry dates: large/medium red 31 Mar, small red 30 Jun, orange 30 Sep, green 31 Dec. Orange/green can auto-renew on self-certification.
law: Water Act 1974 s.25; Air Act 1981 s.21
form: CTO renewal (separate fee for Air & Water)

title: Hazardous waste authorisation renewal
what: Authorisation for generation/storage of hazardous waste (e.g. spent solvents, rejects).

title: Hazardous waste annual return (Form 4)
what: By 30 June for the previous April–March.

title: Environmental Statement (Form V)
what: Annual environmental statement by 30 September.

title: Hazardous waste dispatch records & manifests
what: Form 3 records and Form 10 manifest for every dispatch to TSDF/recycler.

title: EPR plastic packaging — annual return
what: Brand owners file the annual return on the CPCB EPR portal (normally 30 June; FY 2025-26 extended to 31 Dec 2026). MSME status does not exempt registration.
law: Plastic Waste Management Rules 2016, Sch. II (amended 2026)

title: EPR plastic — buy certificates to meet the year's target
what: 2026-27 minimum recycling: Cat I & IV 70%, Cat II & III 50% of obligation. Buy certificates before year-end.

title: Stack & effluent monitoring (consent conditions)
what: Third-party monitoring of stack/ETP as required by the CTO conditions.

title: Bio-medical waste annual report (Form II)
what: Only if a microbiology lab/OHC generates bio-medical waste.

title: EPF contribution + ECR
what: By 15th of next month. Wage ceiling is now ₹25,000 (from 17 Sep 2026) — check who is newly covered.
law: Code on Social Security 2020; EPF Scheme

title: ESIC contribution
what: By 15th of next month (0.75% + 3.25% of gross up to ₹21,000).

title: Punjab State Development Tax — employer deposit
what: ₹200/month for each employee liable to income tax; deposit by last day of next month.

title: Punjab State Development Tax — owner/Karta/self
what: ₹2,400 a year (lump sum option) for the business itself/proprietor.

title: Punjab Labour Welfare Fund — half-yearly remittance
what: Deduct monthly; remit with return by 15 Apr and 15 Oct (₹5 employee + ₹20 employer per month — confirm current rate on pblabour).

title: Statutory bonus paid
what: Within 8 months of year-end (30 Nov). Minimum 8.33%. Keep bonus register; file annual return if state rules ask.

title: Annual Employment Information Return (Form XXVI)
what: Within 30 days of year-end; replaces quarterly ER-I. Confirm headcount threshold with consultant.
law: Code on Social Security 2020 s.139; SS (Central) Rules 2026

title: Report vacancy to Career Centre before hiring
what: Vacancies paying ₹11,000+ a month must be reported before filling.

title: Apprentices — engage 2.5%–15% and register
what: 30+ workers (incl. contract) must engage apprentices via the national portal.

title: POSH annual report to District Officer
what: Internal Committee's report for the previous calendar year, by 31 January. Committee must exist (10+ employees).

title: Minimum wage / VDA revision applied
what: Punjab revises minimum wages/VDA periodically; update payroll.
law: Code on Wages 2019; Code on Wages (Punjab) Rules

title: Shops & Establishment — registration (20+) or intimation (<20)
what: Offices/godowns: 20+ workers register within 6 months of start; under 20 only give intimation.

title: Contract labour — licence/registration & returns
what: Under OSH Code, contractor licensing from 50 contract workers; half-yearly returns.

title: Gratuity paid within 30 days of exit
what: Pay gratuity within 30 days of becoming payable.

title: Appointment letter to every new worker
what: OSH Code requires appointment letters.

title: GSTR-1 (monthly)
what: Outward supplies by 11th. File before GSTR-3B (3B auto-fills from it).

title: GSTR-3B (monthly)
what: Summary return + tax payment by 20th.

title: GSTR-1 (quarterly, QRMP)
what: By 13th after the quarter (IFF optional for months 1–2).

title: GSTR-3B (quarterly, QRMP — Punjab 24th)
what: Punjab is in the 24th-day group.

title: PMT-06 tax payment (QRMP months 1 & 2)
what: Pay tax by 25th for the first two months of each quarter.

title: ITC reconciliation with GSTR-2B
what: Match purchase register with 2B before filing 3B; follow up suppliers.

title: Last date to claim last year's ITC / correct last year's returns
what: 30 Nov (or GSTR-9 filing, if earlier) closes ITC and corrections for the previous year.

title: GSTR-9 annual return
what: By 31 Dec (mandatory above ₹2 crore).

title: GSTR-9C reconciliation
what: Self-certified reconciliation, above ₹5 crore.

title: E-invoice / e-way bill discipline
what: Every B2B invoice gets an IRN; e-way bills for movement. Monthly check of missed IRNs.

title: LUT for zero-rated exports
what: File LUT before 1 April for the next year to export without paying IGST.

title: TDS/TCS deposit
what: By 7th of next month; March deduction by 30 April.

title: TDS returns — Form 138 (salary) / 140 (others)
what: 31 Jul, 31 Oct, 31 Jan, 31 May. New forms replaced 24Q/26Q from Tax Year 2026-27.
law: Income-tax Act 2025 s.397(3)(b); IT Rules 2026 r.219

title: TDS certificates — Form 131 (non-salary)
what: Within 15 days of the quarterly return due date.

title: Salary TDS certificate — Form 130
what: To every employee by 15 June.

title: Advance tax instalments
what: Pay advance tax by these dates.

title: Tax audit report
what: Normally 30 Sep (AY 2026-27 extended to 21 Oct 2026).

title: Income-tax return (audit case)
what: Normally 31 Oct (AY 2026-27 extended to 21 Nov 2026).
penalty: Late fee + interest; loss carry-forward lost.

title: Income-tax return (no audit)
what: Non-audit business returns (confirm the year's date).

title: Pay MSE suppliers within 45 days
what: Review payables to micro/small suppliers; unpaid beyond 45 days is not tax-deductible until paid and attracts interest.
law: MSMED Act s.15–16; Income-tax provision (old s.43B(h))

title: Books closed & statutory audit (company)
what: Audited accounts ready well before AGM.

title: Board meeting (at least 4 a year, gap ≤120 days)
what: Hold one each quarter; minutes signed within 30 days.

title: Annual General Meeting
what: By 30 Sep (first AGM within 9 months of first FY end).

title: ADT-1 auditor appointment
what: Within 15 days of AGM (when auditor appointed/re-appointed).

title: AOC-4 financial statements
what: Within 30 days of AGM.

title: MGT-7/7A annual return
what: Within 60 days of AGM.

title: DPT-3 return of deposits/loans
what: By 30 June (nil return too if outstanding loans/exempt deposits).

title: MSME-1 half-yearly return
what: 31 Oct (Apr–Sep) and 30 Apr (Oct–Mar) for dues to MSEs over 45 days.

title: DIR-3 KYC (every 3 years) for each director
what: Since 31 Mar 2026 once in three years by 30 June of the due year; also within 30 days of any change in mobile/email/address.
law: Companies (Appointment & Qualification of Directors) Rules r.12A

title: INC-20A commencement of business
what: Within 180 days of incorporation (capital paid-in proof).

title: Director disclosures (MBP-1, DIR-8) at first board meeting of the year
what: Each director's interest (MBP-1) and non-disqualification (DIR-8).

title: Event filings within 30 days (DIR-12, PAS-3, MGT-14, INC-22, CHG-1)
what: Director change, share allotment, special resolutions, office change, charges.

title: IEC annual update (1 Apr – 30 Jun)
what: Confirm/update IEC every year even if nothing changed, or it is de-activated.

title: RCMC renewal (Pharmexcil / relevant council)
what: RCMC valid 5 years; needed for export benefits.

title: Export proceeds realised within 9 months (12 if in ₹)
what: From 1 Oct 2026 the limit is 9 months from shipment (12 if invoiced/settled in INR). Review open EDPMS bills monthly; seek AD bank extension in time.
law: FEMA (Export & Import of Goods & Services) Regulations 2026, amended 22-09-2026

title: Country product registrations & dossiers
what: Track each importing-country registration expiry.

title: Importing-country coding/serialisation check per order
what: DGFT track & trace was withdrawn from 1 Feb 2025; follow the buyer country's coding rules instead.

title: UCPMP self-declaration + marketing expenditure disclosure
what: Executive head's declaration and expenditure statement within 2 months of year-end (to association or DoP UCPMP portal).

title: Promotional material & samples review (UCPMP)
what: No gifts to doctors; samples within limits and recorded; promo claims backed by evidence.

title: LMPC registration — annual update of particulars
what: Registration now valid till cancelled, but companies/firms must update address, products (with last year's quantity) and origin every year; name the responsible director.

title: Veg/non-veg symbol on cosmetics — confirm current rule
what: Sept 2026 amendment (G.S.R. 826(E)) changed Rule 6 — sources disagree whether the dot is now voluntary. Get written advice and fix artwork policy.

title: DPDP Act — core obligations go live
what: Privacy notices, consent, security safeguards, breach reporting, data retention/erasure for customer & employee data.

title: Trademark deadlines (tracked in Trademarks tab)
what: Renewals (every 10 years), oppositions, hearings — see Trademarks.

title: Digital signature certificate (DSC) expiry
what: Renew DSCs used for GST/MCA/IT/DGFT before expiry.

title: Law watch: Punjab Labour Code rules (Wages notified; IR/OSH/SS draft)
what: Check pblabour.gov.in for final Punjab rules and new forms; update registers/returns.

title: Law watch: Jan Vishwas changes to D&C Act from 30 Jun 2027
what: Some D&C offences become penalties; update SOPs/training.

title: Vehicle insurance renewal
what: Third-party insurance is compulsory for every vehicle.

title: Vehicle PUC certificate
what: Pollution-under-control certificate (usually 6–12 months).

title: Commercial vehicle fitness, permit & road tax
what: Only for goods/commercial vehicles.

title: Rent / lease agreement renewal
what: Renew and register before expiry; the address on every licence depends on it.

title: Municipal property tax
what: Pay the year's property tax (rebate if paid early, penalty and interest after the due date).

title: Data backup check (accounts, Hub, e-mails)
what: Confirm last backups exist and one restore works; part of reasonable security under the DPDP Act.
penalty: Data loss; DPDP penalties from May 2027.

title: Expired / near-expiry stock review
what: Separate and label expired stock; never sell or dispatch it; plan returns for near-expiry.
law: D&C Act s.18 (sale of expired/NSQ drug); Schedule M stores

title: Store temperature & humidity log review
what: Daily logs complete; excursions investigated.

title: Physical stock verification
what: Count stock and reconcile with books (needed for GST records and bank).

title: Lifts, hoists & lifting tackle — test by competent person
what: Thorough examination at least every 6 months.

title: Pressure plant (autoclave, air receiver) — examination
what: Examination/hydraulic test by a competent person at least every 12 months.

title: Amazon TCS credit reconciliation (GSTR-8 → 3B)
what: Marketplace deducts 1% GST TCS; check it in the portal and claim it in the cash ledger; reconcile sales with the settlement report.

title: Online listing declarations for each product
what: Listing must show manufacturer/packer, MRP, net quantity, country of origin, best-before/expiry, consumer care — same as on pack.
law: LM (PC) Rules 2011 r.6(10); Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules 2020

title: Online buyer complaints & returns review
what: Review complaints, returns and adverse reactions from online buyers; product complaints go into the QA complaint system.
law: Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules 2020; Schedule M / Cosmetics complaints

title: Bank stock statement & limit renewal
what: Monthly stock/debtors statement to the bank; annual renewal of the limit with CA papers.

title: Other / one-off compliance (anything not listed)
what: Use for any notice, inspection reply, court/department letter or new requirement. Write what it is when you create it.
